messages:
jess (PM): quick sync — i've sketched a candidate plan for post-launch weeks 2–6. want to lock down which bugs we treat as emergency patches vs schedule for the next minor, and which enhancements we can defer. thoughts?

omar (eng): skimmed it. curious on perf regressions on streaming path — how many customers hit that?

maria (CS): two active accounts reported increased tail latency after deploy; both on Dedicated. they're flagged as high-touch.

li (design): UX polish items listed are small but visible: tooltip alignment, loading placeholder mismatch. not user-blocking but impacts perception.

jess (PM): proposal: 1) P0 hotfix: streaming tail latency for Dedicated customers (ship within 3 days) 2) P1 patch: critical UX polish + one crash fix (2-week sprint) 3) Backlog prune: batch low-signal feature requests into a triage bucket for Q3.

sam (data): +1 to P0 — telemetry shows 98th pct latency spike correlates with large-batch prefixes. small rollback experiment reduced it.

omar (eng): can confirm rollback reduces tail. two options: A) roll kernel selection change back (fast) B) deeper KV-cache fix (longer). A buys time.

jess (PM): decision criteria I used: customer impact (active contracts), regression risk, engineering cost, and visibility. sharing checklist:

```
Decision checklist:
- Active customer impact? (yes/no)
- Regression severity (crash/functional/ux)
- Rollback available? (yes/no)
- Effort estimate (days)
- Canary surface? (percent)
```

li (design): canary gating for UX changes is tricky; prefer to ship UX with backend canary so perception stays consistent.

maria (CS): recommend P0 for accounts A and B, escalate to account leads and offer mitigation (fallback routing) while we patch.

omar (eng): I'll do rollback A tonight if product signs off. then schedule KV-cache fix in next sprint. estimate: rollback 3-6 hours, KV fix 5-7 days.

jess (PM): thumbs on the table: do we run rollback A now? @omar do you need a release branch and patch notes?

triage-bot: patch-release: create branch "hotfix/stream-tail-1770" — status: queued

sam (data): +1 from me. metrics alerting configured for rollback so we can watch 99th pct.

li (design): design approves rollback; will prepare a short blurb for release notes about perceived improvements.

maria (CS): i'll message both customers + their AMs with planned rollback window and mitigation steps.

jess (PM): ok action plan: 1) omar performs rollback tonight (owner: omar) 2) cs outreach (owner: maria) 3) monitor metrics (owner: sam) 4) schedule KV-cache deeper fix for sprint starting Mon (owner: omar) 5) backlog prune session Fri (owner: jess + li).

omar (eng): starting branch now, will post deploy window in #release-war-room.

jess (PM): perfect. if rollback stabilizes, we close P0. then re-evaluate whether any UX polish should be accelerated into the P1 patch. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria (CS): noted — followups will go into the ticket and i'll add customers to the watchlist.

sam (data): will post dashboards and alert thresholds post-deploy.

jess (PM): logging next steps into the release ticket and will send a short summary to exec. end thread.
